# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [v0.4.0] - 2026-04-12
### Added
- Coding-agent workflow support with a JSON index file describing packed content, symbol metadata, and token budgets for agent consumption
- Sidecar contract that carries pack metadata alongside the Markdown, with minimal and compact payload variants
- Standalone unpacker embedded in packs so files can be reconstructed with python3 alone, including stub reconstruction
- Context metadata sourced from installed package and project setup information
- Fallback version resolution when the package version cannot be determined dynamically
- Sidecar version 3 with analysis metadata and a dedicated pack pipeline, plus configurable sidecar locator and index-JSON validation
- Additional codecrate.toml configuration parameters and normalized index-JSON payloads generated from a shared intermediate representation
- Lean agent and portable-agent profiles tuned for low-token and self-contained agent contexts

### Changed
- Updated README and agent-workflow, format, and CLI documentation for the sidecar and index-JSON features

### Fixed
- Standalone unpacker reconstruction bugs

<!-- generated by releaseledger -->

## [v0.3.2] - 2026-02-07
### Added
- --no-dedupe option to disable function-body deduplication, plus validation and patch improvements
- Output presets that bundle related format and layout options into named profiles
- Version reporting and rules printing for inspecting active scan and formatting rules

<!-- generated by releaseledger -->

## [v0.3.1] - 2026-02-07
### Added
- Dry-run mode that previews a pack, patch, or validate operation without writing files
- Reporting of skipped files and additional packing diagnostics
- doctor command to diagnose a codecrate installation and print command to inspect resolved configuration

### Fixed
- Windows-specific path handling in file discovery

<!-- generated by releaseledger -->

## [v0.3.0] - 2026-02-07
### Added
- Secure symlink handling that bounds traversal to the packed root and rejects unsafe links
- Max byte and token limits to cap pack size and stay within model context windows
- Pack versioning and a --strict mode that fails validation on inconsistencies
- Top-level CLI help summarizing available commands
- Machine header for fast pack validation without parsing the full document
- Configurable content-scanning rules governing which file contents are included or stubbed

### Changed
- File-discovery now uses pathspec 1.0.0 for gitignore matching

### Fixed
- Parsing and packing bugs that broke output on Windows

<!-- generated by releaseledger -->

## [v0.2.0] - 2026-02-06
### Added
- Token counting and a per-pack summary so total token cost is visible before sending to an LLM
- nav_mode option to reduce token usage by controlling how navigation metadata is emitted
- Line numbering and an improved how-to-use intro section in generated packs
- Tool configuration through a tool.codecrate section in pyproject.toml as an alternative to codecrate.toml
- Symbol parsing for languages beyond Python plus a security filter that strips or fences sensitive content
- Multi-repository handling with per-repository validation and unpacking

<!-- generated by releaseledger -->

## [v0.1.0] - 2026-01-23
### Added
- Initial codecrate release packing a Python repository into a Markdown context pack with symbol indexing, deduplication, stubs and full layouts, and gitignore-aware scanning
- Directory tree rendering in generated packs for at-a-glance repository navigation
- unpack, patch, and apply commands to reconstruct files from a pack and to generate or apply diff-only Markdown patches
- Version 4 pack format with structured file fences and an embedded manifest
- Full layout mode that emits complete file contents alongside the existing stubs layout
- Manifest parameter and token-budget-aware splitting of large packs into multiple Markdown files

### Changed
- Initial Sphinx documentation, CLI reference, and quickstart guide

### Fixed
- Markdown rendering and line-handling bugs in generated pack output
